channel.title: Majorca Daily Bulletin - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Majorca Daily Bulletin (majorcadailybulletin.com)

item.title: Eight tourists accused of gang rape in Magalluf accept 72 years in prison
item.description: The eight defendants, all of French nationality except for one Swiss national, have admitted that on 14 August 2023 they went to a hotel room in Magalluf where one of them was staying, accompanied by the victim.

item.title: The Mallorca Energy Summit will bring together tourism, technology and political leaders in Palma
item.description: The forum aims to become a meeting point between engineering, tourism management and investment capital to define how the Spanish and Caribbean hotel industry will tackle its energy transformation between now and 2030.

item.title: Tourists flee Dubai for Mallorca: luxury villa requests triple following Middle East tensions
item.description: "They have told us they prefer to come to Mallorca because it is a safer destination."

item.title: Britons flying to Spain to be hit by rise in flight tax from April 1
item.description: The British government is about to hike Air Passenger Duty which will add to increases in airfares.

item.title: Mallorca Cathedral terraces reopen with stunning views of Palma
item.description: The terraces also offer stunning views over Palma Bay and the city.

item.title: Soller town hall creates 700 parking spaces exclusively for residents
item.description: Soller town hall has introduced approximately 700 parking spaces reserved solely for residents within the newly established Low Emission Zone (Zona de Bajas Emisiones, ZBE), which came into effect on February 27th. These spaces are found inside the LEZ and some adjacent streets, aiming to prioritise local residents' parking while encouraging visitors to use park-and-ride facilities located on the outskirts of the town.

item.title: Spain calls for fuel and energy price caps in response to ‘enormous increases’ as Middle East conflict drags on: concern in the Balearics
item.description: The Prime Minister, Pedro Sánchez, has been asked to resubmit a royal decree-law to Parliament that would set maximum prices for certain products and services in emergency situations.

item.title: Hailstorm turns Lluc Sanctuary white during sudden Mallorca cold snap
item.description: A sudden hailstorm has turned parts of the mountains of Mallorca white this morning, with striking images, shared by Meteo de les Illes, emerging from the area around Lluc Sanctuary. Photographs show the historic sanctuary and surrounding landscape briefly covered in a white layer following an early-morning burst of hail.

item.title: Mallorca weather forecast for Tuesday, March 10 more rain and hail: Foreign Office travel advice after one dead in Spain
item.description: Another few wet days until conditions improve, severe rainfall on the mainland has claimed one life.

item.title: All families with children in Spain to receive 200 euros per month per child from government
item.description: It could cost the Spanish government 19 billion euros a year.
